sources.title: Connected Nations - Planned Network Deployments 2026
facts: The report is forward-looking and is based on operator plans as of January 2026 over the next three years.
If all plans are realised, full fibre could reach 28.1 million UK homes and gigabit-capable coverage 29 million homes by January 2029.
High Confidence plans require at least Low Level Design Complete status and committed funding.
Rural gigabit-capable coverage could rise from 66% to 86% by January 2029 if all plans are realised.
Around 6,950 additional geographically distinct FWA masts are planned or set for upgrade between January 2026 and January 2029.

sources.title: Connected Nations - Planned Network Deployment background
facts: The PND report supplements Ofcom's infrastructure reports and covers proposals within the next three years.
The statutory scope includes new very high capacity networks and fixed or FWA upgrades capable of at least 100 Mbit/s.
Published data are aggregated and anonymised because operator plans are commercially sensitive.
Operator and property coverage data sent to the Secretary of State are not published.
Deployment plans remain forecasts and cannot be treated as comprehensive or definitive.

sources.title: January 2026 OMR and premises in BDUK plans (England and Wales)
facts: The publication was released on 4 June 2026 and applies to England and Wales.
It includes a UPRN-level user guide, a sample CSV and regional ZIP packages.
Regional packages are published separately, including a London package.
The data describe BDUK's premises-level view of January 2026 OMR determinations.
Current connectivity, future commercial plans and BDUK interventions are distinct fields and time states.

sources.title: Premises contracted and built, Project Gigabit contracts
facts: BDUK publishes monthly updates for premises contracted and built under each Project Gigabit contract.
The collection page was last updated on 20 July 2026.
The collection contains monthly releases from October 2025 through July 2026.
The collection concerns hard-to-reach communities and gigabit-capable broadband.
Monthly publication presence does not by itself establish exact parcel service availability.

sources.title: May 2026: Premises contracted and built under Project Gigabit contracts
facts: Supplier resubmissions reduced reported built premises for two contracts and were not treated as delivery-performance deterioration.
Contracted premises cover initial scope and exclude possible deferred scope.
Management information is not directly comparable with official subsidy-attributable delivery statistics.
The snapshot was held on 21 May and has variable ingestion lag.
Figures are rounded to the nearest 10 and require rounding tolerance.

sources.title: Future of Rural England Report
facts: The report states rural gigabit-capable availability at 66% compared with 93% in urban areas.
It reports about 21,218 rural premises in England without decent fixed or FWA broadband.
It reports 63% all-operator indoor 4G coverage for rural premises versus 96% for urban premises.
The SRN core objective of 95% geographic 4G coverage from at least one operator was reached ahead of schedule.
Targeted SRN delivery continues through January 2027 and satellite solutions are expected to widen during 2026.

sources.title: Connectivity and Accessibility Statistics for Rural England - July 2026
facts: The official statistics page was updated on 22 July 2026.
The July 2026 release updates broadband and mobile coverage analysis.
Supplementary tables use Rural-Urban Classification categories.
Local-authority tables provide disaggregated data where feasible.
Area-level statistics require geography and denominator preservation before any local scoring.
